unknown_command.description: Sent when a user sends a command the bot doesn't recognize

start_command.other: Hi, I'm ClipHarborBot. Send me a TikTok, YouTube, or Instagram link and I'll download the video for you.

change_language_message.description: Prompt shown together with the /lang language-picker keyboard

selected_language_message.description: Confirmation sent after a user picks a language from the keyboard

expected_size.description: Shows the estimated download size before the download starts; {{.Size}} is a human-readable byte size, e.g. "12 MiB"

downloading.description: Status update shown while yt-dlp is downloading the video

uploading.description: Status update shown while the bot uploads the downloaded file to Telegram

invalid_url.description: Sent when the message text isn't a valid URL for the matched platform
invalid_url.other: ❌ Invalid URL. Please send a valid link.

download_error.description: Generic fallback error shown when downloading the video fails for an unmapped reason
download_error.other: ❌ Error downloading video. Please try again later.

upload_error.description: Sent when uploading the downloaded video to Telegram fails
upload_error.other: ❌ Error uploading video. Please try again later.

size_error.description: Sent when the video exceeds Telegram's upload size limit
size_error.other: ❌ Video is too large. Telegram only allows files up to 50MB.

format_error.description: Sent when no acceptable mp4 format is available for the video
format_error.other: ❌ Unsupported video format. Try a different format or link.

rate_limited.description: Sent when a user exceeds the per-user download rate limit
rate_limited.other: ⏳ Too many requests. Please wait a few seconds and try again.
